About these terms

harni.uk is the author website of Harni Muharami (“I”, “me”). By using it you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the site. They sit alongside the privacy notice and the cookies notice, and they do not take away any right you have under the law that cannot be excluded. Contact: info@harni.uk.

Books, Amazon and purchases

This site introduces my books and gives ways to contact me. It does not take orders, collect payments or provide a checkout. Each buy link opens the book's page on Amazon.co.uk, where Amazon is the seller and its own terms apply to the sale, delivery, returns and refunds. Check the edition, format, price, availability and seller on Amazon before you buy. Kindle Unlimited access depends on Amazon's current offer and your eligibility.

Book information on this site, such as titles, descriptions, publication dates, page counts and formats, is taken from the Amazon listings and may lag behind a change there. Where they differ, the Amazon listing for the edition you are buying is correct. My Amazon links contain no affiliate tag. See delivery and refunds for where to get help with an order.

General guidance, not advice

The books and this website offer general education, information and reflection for healthcare professionals and other readers. They are not medical, clinical, nursing, legal, employment, financial or psychological advice, they are not a diagnosis or treatment, and they are not official NHS, regulatory or professional-body guidance. They do not replace your own professional judgement, your registration obligations, your employer's policies or the advice of a suitably qualified person who knows your situation.

Healthcare practice, law and guidance change. Check current, authoritative sources and local policy before relying on anything in a book, and never use a book or this site to make an urgent decision about a patient or yourself. If you or someone else is in danger or seriously unwell, contact the emergency services or a clinician straight away.

I make no promise about any particular result, outcome, career step or level of wellbeing. Where a book describes an approach that worked for others, it may not work for you.

Personal capacity and no endorsement

I write in a personal capacity. These are my views, not those of my employer. I am an NHS nurse and clinical educator, but this website and my books are my own work. They are not produced, reviewed, approved or endorsed by the NHS, any NHS organisation or any employer, and nothing here is an official statement by them. NHS and other organisation names are used only to describe my background and who my books are for.

Case examples in books and on this site are general illustrations. They are not intended to identify any real patient, colleague or workplace, and they must not be used to identify one.

Messages and sign-ups you send me

You are responsible for what you send. Only send material you have the right to share, and do not send anything unlawful, abusive, defamatory or confidential, or any patient or workplace information. Sending a message creates no professional, clinical, advisory or client relationship between us, and I cannot give personal medical, clinical or legal advice.

By sending a message you give me permission to read it, store it and reply to it as described in the privacy notice. It does not give me permission to publish it. I will not quote your words or name you on this site unless you agree in writing first. An automatic reference copy is an acknowledgement, not a promise of a reply by a set date.

Book-update emails are sent only to people who ticked the consent box. You can unsubscribe at any time.

Events and enquiries

An enquiry about an event does not reserve a date or agree a fee, attendance or content. Any arrangement has to be agreed directly and in writing. Where an event is run by an organiser, their booking terms apply to you, and I am not responsible for what they do.

Copyright and trade marks

The books, the text, images, designs and other material on this site belong to me or to the rights holder named, and are protected by copyright. You may read the site, share links to it and quote short extracts for criticism, review, quotation or other uses the law allows (known as fair dealing), with a clear credit to Harni Muharami and the title. Beyond that, please ask in writing before you copy, republish, translate, adapt or sell any part of it. Buying or borrowing a book gives you the right to read that copy and does not transfer any copyright.

Amazon, Kindle, Kindle Unlimited, Instagram, TikTok, Cloudflare and NHS are names or trade marks of their owners. I have no connection with them beyond using their services or describing my work, and their use here is not an endorsement.

Using the site properly

Please do not misuse the site. In particular, do not impersonate anyone, submit another person's details without their permission, send spam, try to gain unauthorised access, introduce malicious code, overload the forms, scrape the site in a way that disrupts it, or use the forms to email people who have not asked to hear from you. I may block access or report abuse where the law allows.

Pier Run is a free game for a short break. It has no prizes, no paid entry and no online leaderboard, and scores stay on your device. Take regular breaks, and stop playing if the movement or flashing bothers you.

Links, availability and accuracy

Other websites and services are independent. A link is not a recommendation, and I am not responsible for their content, availability or privacy practices. I take care to keep this site accurate and running, but I cannot promise it will always be available, error-free or up to date, and I may change, pause or remove any part of it. If you spot a mistake, please tell me through the contact page.

My responsibility to you

Nothing in these terms limits or excludes my liability for death or personal injury caused by negligence, for fraud or fraudulent misrepresentation, or for anything else that cannot lawfully be limited or excluded. If you are a consumer, your statutory rights, including those under the Consumer Rights Act 2015, are not affected.

Subject to that, and because this site and its content are provided free and for general information: (a) they are provided “as is”, without any promise that they are complete, current or suitable for your purposes; (b) I am not responsible for losses that come from relying on general information here instead of professional advice, from decisions you make about patient care, your work or your health, or from the actions of third parties such as Amazon or other linked services; and (c) I am not responsible for loss of profit, business, revenue or opportunity, or for any loss I could not reasonably have foreseen. My total responsibility for any claim connected with the free use of this site is limited to the extent the law allows.

Changes, law and disputes

I may update these terms when the site or the law changes. The version date at the top shows which version applies. Changes do not take away rights you already have, and they apply to your use of the site after the change. If any part of these terms is found not to be enforceable, the rest stays in force. These terms and the free use of this site are governed by the law of England and Wales, and the courts of England and Wales can hear disputes, but if you are a consumer living elsewhere in the UK you keep any right to bring a claim in your local courts. Please contact me first at info@harni.uk if you have a concern, and I will try to put it right. You may also contact a regulator or use any complaints process that applies.
